channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Boring Co. moves closer to putting station at UNLV campus
item.description: After months of controversy surrounding the company for unsafe working conditions, regents unanimously OK plans for a tunnel underneath the university.

item.title: 'They’re trying': State hopes to reverse course on poor pregnancy care. Progress is slow.
item.description: Nevada lags behind the nation on many pregnancy health care-related metrics. It's one of just three states lacking a central authority to monitor the issue.

item.title: OPINION: Stick that extra hour where the sun don’t shine
item.description: To understand why we have daylight saving time, one must ask: Which business sectors might want the maximum number of daylight hours so people will stay out later and spend more money on their stuff?

item.title: OPINION: Book in hand and Trump in mind, Newsom takes his roadshow through Boulder City
item.description: His Boulder City stop was more about political panache than policy. But if Newsom had been looking for a place to speak on the water, environmental and energy challenges that face the arid West, he could hardly have picked a better spot.

item.title: Nevada will use AI for unemployment appeals. Some lawmakers are skeptical.
item.description: State officials have touted AI as a way to simplify and accelerate existing processes, but they have also cautioned that it must not replace human oversight. Still, there are skeptics in the Legislature about the project’s security and transparency.

item.title: IndyTalks: Lombardo pushes against nationalizing elections, calls it ‘state issue’
item.description: Read our recap of the governor's 90-minute talk with Nevada Independent CEO Jon Ralston, which covered everything from vaccines and election security to the Colorado River and transgender athletes.

item.title: Gobernador Lombardo se opone a nacionalización de las elecciones, lo llama 'asunto de estado'
item.description: Lea nuestro resumen de la charla de 90 minutos del gobernador con el Director Ejecutivo de The Nevada Independent, Jon Ralston, que abordó temas como vacunas, seguridad electoral el Río Colorado y atletas transgénero, entre otros.

item.title: Lombardo says traditional education is not working. His answer? Expand school choice.
item.description: Though Gov. Joe Lombardo has taken small steps to provide more schooling options for students, he said he considered it a disappointment he hasn’t been able to do more.

item.title: Once a beacon of cheap homes, Nevada has become a symbol of America's struggle with high costs
item.description: Once a beacon of cheap homes, Nevada has become a symbol of America’s struggle with high costs. Home prices in Las Vegas rose 64 percent from early 2020 to last year, despite recent declines.

item.title: Cortez Masto blames Trump for cuts to Nevada hospital
item.description: She said Medicaid cuts in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act have forced Boulder City Hospital to make “sacrifices,” including ending overnight stays.
